name: Machbannai
overview: Machbannai was a male member of the tribe of Gad who is noted in Scripture as the eleventh Gadite to join David at Ziklag. His arrival with David's followers highlights his role among those who united with David during a critical period of his leadership. This association places Machbannai within the loyal supporters of David as recorded in 1 Chronicles 12:13.
namesAndTitles: The name Machbannai means 'clad with a cloak,' which is a proper name recorded in 1 Chronicles 12:13. There is no indication that this name was given by God, but it reflects a distinctive Hebrew personal name of the period.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Machbannai as a descendant of Gad, linking him to this tribe of Israel. Beyond this tribal affiliation, no further family relationships are recorded for him in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Machbannai's significance lies in his inclusion among the Gadites who came to David at Ziklag, evidencing the broad support David received from various tribal groups. His position as the eleventh Gadite to join David underscores the organized and numbered nature of these supporters. This contributes to the biblical narrative of David's consolidation of leadership and the gathering of his followers during his rise to kingship.
